digest.overview: Quiet window dominated by Anthropic's push into custom AI silicon and on-device moves from Liquid AI/MacPaw. Steady stream of local LLM benchmarks and a wave of arXiv papers on benchmarks, quantization, and agentic systems. No major model drops or frontier announcements.

top_story.headline: Anthropic building custom AI chip design team
top_story.summary: Anthropic is hiring a dedicated team to design its own AI chips, planning to co-design hardware and models for faster, more efficient Claude inference.
top_story.why_it_matters: Signals shift from API/cloud reliance toward vertical integration; follows similar moves by Google, Meta, and others amid rising inference costs.

sentiment.label: mixed
sentiment.summary: Community focused on practical local runs and infra strategy rather than hype; skepticism around open models in policy and universities preferring no AI.

model_releases.headline: Qwen3-TTS voice cloning merged into mainline llama.cpp
model_releases.summary: Full support for Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base GGUF now in llama.cpp master, enabling real on-device voice cloning.

model_releases.headline: LFM2.5-2.6B running at 17 tok/s on OnePlus 13 (pure CPU, Q4_K_M)
model_releases.summary: 2.69B model with 128K context optimized for agent workflows demonstrated on mobile CPU via custom inference engine.

frontier_labs.headline: Anthropic hiring AI chip design team
frontier_labs.summary: Team to co-design custom silicon with models for efficiency gains.

frontier_labs.headline: MacPaw partners with Liquid AI for on-device inference
frontier_labs.summary: MacPaw building local Eney assistant using Liquid AI models for its app store developers.

frontier_labs.headline: Google Assistant to be removed from Android phones and tablets Sept 4
frontier_labs.summary: Gemini fully replaces Assistant across devices including watches and headphones.

research_radar.headline: Position: LLMs Can't Jump
research_radar.summary: OpenReview challenge paper arguing fundamental limits in LLM capabilities for certain tasks.

research_radar.headline: Zero-Mem: Zero-Token Memory Operations for LLM Agents
research_radar.summary: arXiv paper proposing memory ops without token overhead for agents.

research_radar.headline: JudgeArena: Unified framework for reproducible LLM-judge evaluation
research_radar.summary: Addresses fragmentation in LLM-as-a-judge benchmarks with standardized protocols.

post_ideas.draft: Anthropic just posted for a full AI chip design team. Vertical integration race is on—next 18 months will show who actually ships silicon that matters.
post_ideas.why_viral: Direct tension on infra strategy vs pure software play; timely with rising capex debates.

post_ideas.draft: Google Assistant disappears from every Android phone Sept 4. The transition is complete—how many users will notice or care?
post_ideas.why_viral: End of an era moment with clear replacement; personal device impact.

post_ideas.draft: Rust is formalizing an LLM policy for contributions. Open source tooling finally confronting the generated-code reality.
post_ideas.why_viral: Contrarian take on code quality vs velocity in core infra project.
